Container.Name: TaskJar
Container.Overview: Household task jar: put small tasks (30 minutes max) in the jar, say how much time you have, and pull one random task that fits. One shared jar for everyone on the home network.[br][br]Set App URL to the exact address you open TaskJar on (for example http://192.168.1.20:3000). Saving and drawing fail with a 403 error if it doesn't match.
Container.DonateText: Enjoying TaskJar? Buy me a coffee.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port TaskJar is published on. Keep App URL in sync with it.

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: Exact URL you open TaskJar on, including the port, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:3000. Required: form submits are rejected (403) without it.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database (taskjar.db). Back up this folder.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as (Unraid default: nobody = 99).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (Unraid default: users = 100).
